evidence: An earlier compatibility fixture failed to compile because HashStr (_HASH_STR) was unbound. After binding the pinned SYS_HASH_STR algorithm, the guest compiler loaded the fixture and verified NULL, empty string, abc, CTask, and a 78-byte carry/fold vector. The class lookup, private-table isolation, shadowing and LastClass terminal recovery checks also passed.
scope_note: This run verifies standalone HashStr values and the named regression cases in QEMU. The subsequent shared-table hash fix and its interoperability tests are recorded in kernel-hash-table-qemu-2026-11-09.json. Live UTM and physical Pi remain unverified.
